claims.text: The FOMC raised the target range for the federal funds rate to 1/2 to 3/4 percent on December 14, 2016.

claims.text: The policy rate (federal funds target range of 1/2 to 3/4 percent) is distinct from the Committee's 2 percent inflation objective, which is a goal, not the policy rate.

citations.quotation: the Committee will assess realized and expected economic conditions relative to its objectives of maximum employment and 2 percent inflation

claims.text: The statement notes inflation was below the 2 percent objective at the time.

citations.quotation: In light of the current shortfall of inflation from 2 percent, the Committee will carefully monitor actual and expected progress toward its inflation goal.
